description.tagline: 10 euros para elegir el regalo perfecto
description.intro: The Gift Card 10 euros soccermania allows you to give away football by letting the person who receives it choose what he really needs. With a value of 10€, it can be used both in physical stores and on the football website to buy among the products available.
key_benefits: Freedom to choose: The person who receives the card can decide on which products to use your 10€.
Flexible shopping: It can be used both in physical stores and in the online football store.
Regalo sin equivocaciones: Evita tener que acertar con la talla, el modelo o las preferencias concretas del destinatario.
For any footballer: A practical option to give away football material allowing each player to find what he or she is looking for.
